rows.text: La direttiva distingue le categorie e le date. Per M2, M3 oltre 5 e fino a 10 t e N2 immatricolati dal 1° ottobre 2001 al 2004, l’obbligo riguarda i veicoli conformi ai limiti di emissione della direttiva 88/77/CEE; dal 2005 riguarda anche le nuove immatricolazioni. Per M3 oltre 10 t e N3 l’obbligo risale a date anteriori. Restano le deroghe previste.
evidence: Direttiva 92/6/CEE, testo consolidato al 4 dicembre 2002, artt. 1, 4(1)-(3) e 6, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A01992L0006-20021204: M3 oltre 10 t e N3 già dal 1994 per immatricolazioni dal 1994; per M2, M3 oltre 5 e fino a 10 t e N2 dal 2005 per nuove immatricolazioni e, per immatricolati tra ottobre 2001 e gennaio 2005 conformi ai limiti della direttiva 88/77/CEE, entro il 2006 per trasporto internazionale e nazionale o il 2007 per solo nazionale; deroghe.

rows.text: Il quiz indica VERO. In alcuni sistemi il limitatore controlla l’alimentazione intervenendo sul comando della pompa d’iniezione, riducendo il carburante quando si raggiunge la velocità impostata. issues.reason: The official Italian “agisce, se presente, sulla pompa di iniezione” does not unambiguously identify whether the limiter or the pump is present; the English and Chinese task translations condition the pump, while Spanish conditions the limiter. The printed VERO does not resolve the referent, and the verified sources establish fuel control and a particular mechanical pump installation, not a universal pump action. Independent source adjudication is needed before the four explanations can resolve the mismatch.
checked_sources: Ministero delle infrastrutture e dei trasporti, quiz superiori question 28670, https://www.ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/85457073/DOMANDE%2BSUPERIORI23-10.pdf/8673967c-c17e-421d-8f67-b711a33194c1?version=1.0: exact ambiguous wording and printed VERO; question 28650 describes diesel injection pump or unit injectors.

Council Directive 92/24/EEC, Annex I section 2.5, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=celex%3A31992L0024: speed limitation device controls fuel feed; it does not resolve the Italian referent or require all designs to act on an injection pump.

VDO, Product Manual AGB III, section 1, pages 1–2, https://www.laltraranda.it/sites/default/files/documenti/agb_iii_x10-397-109-132.pdf: specific limiter operates an actuator on a diesel pump; this example does not settle the referent or demonstrate a universal arrangement.

issues: 28664: Saying that the limiter is not the engine water-cooling circuit does not establish whether the limiter itself is water-cooled. The cited fuel-control function does not substantiate the proposed correction; provide authoritative technical evidence and explain the decisive distinction.

28665: The cited technical requirement permits incorporating a permanent brake if it operates after fuel feed is reduced to minimum. The draft instead says the brake may be incorporated only after that reduction, incorrectly making installation or integration conditional on a later operating event; correct this in all four languages. See Directive 92/24/EC Annex I 7.1.3 https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=celex%3A31992L0024.

28669: The cited Directive 2014/47/EU link returned a bot verification page, so the claim about the inspection of condition and operation could not be independently verified against that cited provision. Provide accessible authoritative evidence or verify the exact Annex II point 7.10.

28651, 28661–28665, 28670, 28675–28676: The cited UNECE Regulation 89 consolidated link could not be inspected (access error/bot verification).
